design.name: 相柳
design.brief: Xiangliu (相柳), minister of the flood god Gonggong in the Shan Hai Jing ('nine heads, a snake body, coiled; wherever it touches becomes poisonous swamp'): a colossal coiled serpent about 8 m tall with NINE long necks rising from one thick body, each ending in a reptile snake head with only faintly human-like eyes (not human faces); dark moss-green and bruise-purple scales in big carved plates, swamp mud and reeds on the coils. Charged with corrupted thunder: magenta-violet lightning veins along the necks, every throat glows, and the largest central head carries a glowing magenta crown spot (weak spot). Monstrous, hydra-like.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
